result.summary: capture-service (fittings/seed/capture-service, faculty channels, own_port 8097) today provides ONLY `kind: channel name: companion`. Its HTTP surface is a hand-rolled node http server in scripts/server.mjs (no express): Bearer CAPTURE_TOKEN routes under /capture/* (devices, sessions, exchanges), unauthenticated own-port surfaces (/, /sessions/<id>[/events] SSE, /speak/<hash>.mp3 clips, /health), loopback/tailnet sinks POST /notify and POST /ack, and one websocket at /capture/stream (Bearer on upgrade; modes audio | screen_audio | pendant; 17-byte binary Opus/JPEG frames; JSON control session_start/session_end/feedback_ack/spoken). STT is lib/deepgram-live.mjs TranscriptionLane: one Deepgram live websocket per SESSION fed Opus packets (encoding=opus, 16k mono, nova-3, pt) - there is no one-shot clip/batch endpoint, so a browser push-to-talk clip needs either a new short-lived session through the lane or a new REST /stt path. TTS is lib/tts.mjs ZecaVoice: ElevenLabs text-to-speech/<voiceId> mp3_44100_128, eleven_multilingual_v2, default voice RlGHmE2fztwdBDat0jYf, content-hash disk cache under $GARRISON_HOME/capture/tts-cache, MAX_TEXT_CHARS cap, `available()` fails closed without ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (phone falls back to AVSpeechSynthesizer; no crash, counters only). The gateway is reached via lib/gateway-client.mjs: POST ${gatewayUrl}/chat with channel "garrison", header x-garrison-origin: channel, three lanes (inferenceRunFn cheap pinned target, operativeRunFn full turn with sessionId/sessionTitle, discussRunFn routing {duty:"discuss",level}); conversation continuity is the gateway `sessionId` (`<originPrefix>-wake:<captureSessionId>`), not mode words. web-channel-default is the existing kind:voice CONSUMER; it discovers the provider by reading ~/.garrison/ui-fittings/deepgram-voice.json (hardcoded filename) and proxies /api/voice/stt|tts|stream|tts-stream to the provider's POST /stt, POST /tts, WS /stream, WS /tts-stream - that is the contract capture-service must implement to replace deepgram-voice. Tests: 12 vitest files tests/capture-service*.test.ts plus pendant-*/companion-e2e; all run against a sandboxed GARRISON_HOME with injected env and mock Deepgram (scripts/mock-deepgram.mjs, cfg.wsFactory). No express/sandbox harness beyond that.

facts.fact: GET /speak/<hex 8-64>.mp3 - unauthenticated, serves cached ElevenLabs clip via voice.readClip; GET /capture/exchanges - Bearer CAPTURE_TOKEN via authorizeHttp, returns {exchanges} (the Conversation screen data: user words, intent, full reply, delivery, follow-up rounds); GET /health and /api/health - unauthenticated status incl. gatewayConfigured; GET / - unauthenticated own-port status page; GET /sessions/<id> and /sessions/<id>/events - unauthenticated transcript page + SSE live segments; POST /capture/devices - Bearer, body {apns_token hex, device_name} -> {ok,count}; GET /capture/sessions - Bearer, list; GET /capture/sessions/<id> - Bearer, one record; POST /notify - NO token (loopback/tailnet trust), body {text, title?, link?, tag?, idempotencyKey?}; /capture/stream over plain HTTP -> 400 'websocket upgrade required'; any other /capture/* -> 501; POST /ack - NO token, kanban fanOutAck sink; else 404.

authorizeHttp: cfg.enabled false -> 403 'capture ingress disabled'; no CAPTURE_TOKEN sealed -> 403 'CAPTURE_TOKEN not sealed'; token mismatch -> 401 'bad token'. tokenMatches is timing-safe digest compare; bearerToken parses 'Bearer <x>' header. Same ladder on websocket upgrade.

Only websocket path is /capture/stream (other paths refused on upgrade). Bearer CAPTURE_TOKEN on upgrade. Control frames JSON: session_start {mode: audio|screen_audio|pendant, consent shown|suppressed, codec opus|opus_fs320 for pendant}, session_end {reason user|error|timeout}, feedback_ack, spoken {spoken:<ackId>, ok, reason?}. Server -> client: {type:'ack', stream, seq}, {type:'speak', ack:{...,audioPath:'/speak/<id>.mp3'}}, {type:'error'}. Binary media: 17-byte LE header [u8 kind][u32 seq][f64 ts_ms][u32 len] kind 0 Opus, kind 1 JPEG. Sessions survive socket drops; session_start with a live id resumes; ended ids refuse to reopen. pendant mode gated on cfg.pendantEnabled.

scripts/capture.mjs is ONLY the verify hook: `--probe` loads config, checks port, prints CAPTURE-OK port=... flags=ingress,transcribe,wake,notify,speak. Serves no HTTP. The server is scripts/server.mjs (started by scripts/start.mjs).

Exports deepgramUrl(cfg), segmentFromResults(msg), class TranscriptionLane {available(), openSession(sessionId)->bool, feed(sessionId, opusBytes), liveSegments(sessionId), subscribe(sessionId, listener), end(sessionId)->segments, close()} plus internal SessionTranscription {connect, feed, armMuteWatchdog, end, subscribe}. One Deepgram websocket per capture session (wss://api.deepgram.com or cfg.dgBaseUrl), params model=cfg.sttModel (nova-3), language=cfg.sttLanguage (pt), encoding=opus, sample_rate=16000, channels=1, interim_results, smart_format, endpointing=300; header authorization: Token <DEEPGRAM_API_KEY>. Streaming ONLY - no batch/prerecorded call; input must be raw Opus packets (normalizeOpusPacket), not webm/wav. A browser push-to-talk clip would need either a new lane path (openSession + feed + end per clip, or Deepgram /v1/listen REST) - nothing exists today. Reconnects with a FEED_QUEUE_MAX 1024-packet buffer; wsFactory injectable for the mock.

POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/<ttsVoiceId>?output_format=mp3_44100_128 with model_id cfg.ttsModel (default eleven_multilingual_v2), deterministic seed, stability/similarity 0.75. Voice id default RlGHmE2fztwdBDat0jYf ('Diogo', pt-PT). Cache dir <stateDir>/tts-cache/<id>.mp3, oldest-first prune to ttsCacheMaxClips (500), pinned ids exempt. result.summary: Mapped three areas. (A) omi-channel is a channels-faculty own-port fitting (port 8094) whose Omi chat tool `ask_zeca` is a manifest served at GET /omi/tools-manifest and answered at POST /omi/chat; both live in fittings/seed/omi-channel/lib/chat.mjs and scripts/server.mjs. Omi transcripts arrive at POST /omi/realtime (in-memory wake detection) and POST /omi/memory and /omi/day-summary (triage); everything reaches the operative through the gateway's POST /chat via lib/gateway-client.mjs (fast lane pins classification T0-trivial; operative lane passes sessionId per capture session). Tests: 10 tests/omi-channel*.test.ts files plus tests/omi-wake-card-commands.test.ts. (B) screen-share-default (surfaces, port 8079) is a 1fps `screencapture -x` JPEG poller with GET /health, /state, /frame and POST /start, /stop; no video, no audio, no recordings - the only artifact is /tmp/garrison-screen-latest.jpg. capture-service (channels, port 8097) already stores 1.5fps frames from the iOS broadcast extension under media/<sessionId>/frames but nothing reads them back; Deepgram live STT is embedded in capture-service (lib/deepgram-live.mjs) and it does not consume deepgram-voice. (C) Gateway = fittings/seed/http-gateway/scripts/gateway-pty.mjs (5512 lines; gateway.mjs is a 6-line shim). Channels POST /chat (blocking JSON {reply, session_id,...}) or POST /chat/stream (SSE events open, route, chunk, tool, activity, session_event, done, error); a conversation is identified by body.sessionId (or web's `thread`) parsed in routeHintsFromBody; web-channel stores messages one file per thread under $GARRISON_HOME/web-channel/threads/<id>.json with a debounced index in the state service (config doc web-channel.threads / node:<name>, sorted by lastMessageAt). There is no gateway-side "active conversation" notion; the nearest is web-channel's runningThreadIds()/runningSince in handleThreadsList. The James/Joe mode-word engine is RETIRED per docs/CAPABILITIES.md:332 and nothing in the gateway or web-channel matches "James". No Watch aptidao (screen-recording digest) exists anywhere in docs or roadmap.json.

facts.fact: Omi chat tool is named `ask_zeca`, one parameter {query}, auth_required:false, served by buildManifest() with endpoint `${publicBaseUrl}/omi/chat?key=<webhookSecret>`; manifest root also declares chat_messages {enabled, target:"main", notify:false} so the fitting can push proactive chat messages.
Server routes: POST /omi/chat (chat tool answer) and GET /omi/tools-manifest (manifest), both gated on `chatTool` being constructed; chat disabled returns 403 "This tool is currently disabled."

ask_zeca tries a fast tool-free lane first (small pinned classifier via gateway /chat with classification {taskType:"other", tier:"T0-trivial"}, ~8.5s budget) and replies WORKING_ANSWER then delegates to the full operative lane asynchronously, pushing the answer later via omi chat_messages/push.

Omi transcripts reach the fitting at POST /omi/realtime (ingress.acceptRealtime, in-memory only, keyed by query.session_id), POST /omi/memory and POST /omi/day-summary (ingress.accept -> store -> triage). Also POST /internal/omi-push, POST /ack, POST /api/threads (thread-append contract, loopback/tailnet only).

All model calls go to the http-gateway `${gatewayUrl}/chat` with header x-garrison-origin: channel and channel:"garrison"; the operative lane (operativeRunFn) passes sessionId/sessionTitle so a capture session maps to one gateway session; gatewayUrl resolves from GARRISON_GATEWAY_URL or GARRISON_GATEWAY_HOST/PORT. No capture-service endpoint is called by omi-channel today.

API: GET/POST /api/threads, /api/threads/:id/*, GET /api/mesh-threads.

The closest is web-channel's handleThreadsList which stamps runningSince from runningThreadIds()/remote-shell state/conversationRunningSince and orders by updatedAt/lastMessageAt.
